messages:
Alex: heads-up: since ~03:55 eu-south1 GPU provisioning failing, lots of attach_pending with reason 'local-nvme: meta_compact stall'.
Maria: same here, seeing compactor cpu spike and iowait on scratch devices. S.M.A.R.T shows ++pending sectors on some nodes.
Sam: logs?
Alex: ```
[03:59:12] compactor: start meta_compact node-42-eus1
[03:59:15] compactor: IOERR checksum_mismatch /dev/nvme0n1
[03:59:15] kernel: nvme: rq 1234 ... fsync stalled
[04:01:02] provisioner: attach_reject node-42-eus1 reason=disk_io_error
```
Priya: did we roll kernel/firmware tonight?
Nora: we pushed kernel 5.10.95 to eu-south1 at 03:50, firmware stays the same. Could be compaction path hitting a firmware edge.
ops-bot: :rotating_light: alert: 95 attach failures in #eu-south1 in last 15m; GPU backlog +420%
Maria: two immediate mitigations: cordon worst nodes + lower compactor concurrency. Bumping compactor concurrency is risky.
Sam: options: 1) route new GPU allocs to eu-west1 (latency/cost hit), 2) spin short-lived dedicated capacity in eu-south1 (expensive), 3) cordon/drain nodes with failing NVMe.
Alex: commands I'm going to run: ```
kubectl cordon node-42-eus1
kubectl drain node-42-eus1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
# toggle compactor
fluxctl set image compactor --set=janitor.compaction.max_concurrency=1
``` 
Nora: I'll cordon a 20-node canary set and watch attach queue. Priya, can you open cross-region routing for small jobs?
Priya: on it, enabling fallback-route-eu-west for <4GiB jobs. FYI cost estimate: ~+35% infra cost for those jobs while backlog persists; also +200ms median latency.
Sam: :eyes: keep support aware. Add a banner? Might be noisy.
Alex: update 15m: after cordoning 18 nodes backlog dropped ~60%, attach failure rate down to ~12/min. Compactor still emitting checksum mismatches on 5 hosts. We'll keep nodes cordoned and run deeper nvme health + firmware check. Filing follow-up postmortem if this persists.
Maria: good triage. assignable owners: @nora for node cordon, @sam for compactor config, @priya for routing & cost comms.
Nora: noted, will post status updates in ops-runbook channel.
Alex: thanks — keeping this thread for timeline. :thumbsup:
